exposure: lower uterine segment transverse purse string suture
cohort: The study included 40 patients with previous cesarean section and complete placenta previa who received a lower uterine segment transverse purse string suture to control hemorrhage after preliminary measures failed during cesarean section.
finding: The lower uterine segment transverse purse string suture successfully secured hemorrhage and preserved the uterus in 37 out of 40 patients (92.5%), including almost all patients with placenta accreta spectrum.
